'''Matcha Flavoured 0.2-alpha''' (published as "v0.2-alpha") is the earliest surviving release of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on Modrinth on June 9, 2026. It targets ''Minecraft'' 26.1.2.

The release replaced an earlier upload, which was deleted because assets belonging to another creator's pack, which the notes call "Jake's Built Tool's" (JBT), had accidentally been packaged with it.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.2-alpha|quote=Jake's Built Tool's Assets was accidentally packaged with my Pack, so the previous version of this pack was DELETED.}}</ref>

== Changes ==
* Assets from another pack that had been bundled by mistake are no longer included.

== Fixes ==
* Fixed [[villager]] trades.
* Fixed [[fishing]], and added a few more catches.
